Hello Rafa,

I know you are very busy and have also been unwell, but I felt it was best to write to you directly and clearly on this, given both the pressing issue of the IEC now falling due on Cercial’s outstanding orders and the importance of defining the future direction of our partnership. For that reason, I am sending you in attachment a draft distribution agreement for Exceptional Spirits to be the exclusive importer in Portugal for Pindorama.

As I am sure you appreciate, Exceptional Spirits has invested considerable time, energy and cash flow into building Pindorama in this market. We have grown sales for the brand, represented it at trade shows at our own cost, including at Cercial’s own trade shows, and visited clients on Cercial’s behalf, even where Exceptional Spirits stood to earn effectively nothing on those sales. We have done this because we believe in the brand and in its long-term potential in Portugal.

At the same time, the current structure with Cercial is no longer workable. It has not been balanced for some time, and Exceptional Spirits cannot continue to carry the commercial burden of building the brand at or near break-even level, particularly now that Cercial has defaulted on payments while also refusing to engage constructively on fair pricing.

The pricing strategy revised with Duarte at the end of last year was intended to:

• correct the imbalance in the current structure;
• create a sustainable budget for brand development and promotional activity;
• allow Exceptional Spirits to retain a standard 20% margin on partner sales;
• allow Exceptional Spirits to fund 11+1 offers in full and reduce its own margin to 10% in the case of 5+1 offers, while partners to retain a clean 20% margin.

I would also like to clarify that direct distribution is not being proposed in order to undercut partners or to increase Exceptional Spirits’ margin disproportionately. It is a common model for importers to sell through a combination of direct fulfiment and partner sales, and one of the few realistic ways for Exceptional Spirits to build the budget needed to invest into key accounts and activations that support long-term growth for a brand with Pindorama’s potential.

I believe the attached draft is fair. It would allow Exceptional Spirits to continue building Pindorama on a sustainable basis, while preserving a clean 20% margin for Cercial and other partners. It also gives Cercial a fair transition, with the pricing change only taking effect for them in September, ahead of the autumn menu changes.

If we formalise our relationship on a structure akin to that which we have with the other brands we represent, Exceptional Spirits would feel more confident in pre-paying the IEC on Cercial’s overdue invoices and in settling all other partner sales, as an investment in a clearer and more sustainable long-term relationship with Pindorama. As set out in the agreement, we would also be happy to move away from a consignment model.

We remain genuinely enthusiastic about Pindorama and would very much like to continue building the brand in Portugal.

I hope you will review the attached draft in that spirit, and I would be very happy to discuss it with you.

With all best wishes,
Anna

Keys

Baboons

Garbage

Parking
Please park directly under the overhang infront of the garage, and ensure you are far enough forward that the baboons cannot use your car as a step up onto the balcony. Wifi

Loadshedding
South Africa experiences government controlled power outages. This is something we do not have control over. You can download the Eskom Se Push app (https://sepush.co.za) to keep up to date with when to expect outages. Select Rooiels (2) for updates in the area.

Petrol Station
The closest Petrol Station is in Bettys Bay. Directions are in our guidebook.

Grocery Stores
The closest grocery stores are in Gordon’s Bay or Kleinmond, which are 25km’s away from the house. I would suggest doing your grocery shopping before you go out to the house.

Alarm System

Cleaning Fee
As specified on Home Exchange, we charge a £100 for up to 4 people and an additional £25 per person fee over 4 pax, to prepare for your arrival & clean after your departure, as this is a large villa.
